scripts.cli:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path cantrip_cli/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path cantrip_cli/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm --filter @cantrip/version build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/logging build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/glitch build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/crypto build && pnpm cli:build && pnpm codex:build && pnpm code:build
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others --names glitch,protocol,server,worker,app --prefix-colors cyan,gray,blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @cantrip/glitch dev" "pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol dev" "cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 CANTRIP_DATA_DIR=../.cantrip/browser-dev pnpm --filter @cantrip/server dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 CANTRIP_WORKER_DATA_DIR=../.cantrip/browser-dev/worker CANTRIP_WORKER_DEVELOPMENT_BOOTSTRAP=true pnpm --filter @cantrip/worker dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && cross-env VITE_CANTRIP_LOCAL_ONLY=true pnpm --filter @cantrip/app dev"
scripts.site: pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/glitch build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/site dev
scripts.dev:server: pnpm --filter @cantrip/version build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/logging build && pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol build && concurrently --kill-others --names database,server --prefix-colors yellow,blue "docker compose -f compose.dev-server.yml up" "cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 node scripts/dev-account-server.mjs"
scripts.dev:postgres: pnpm run dev:prepare && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://cantrip:cantrip@127.0.0.1:54329/cantrip concurrently --kill-others --names database,glitch,protocol,server,worker,app --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,gray,blue,magenta,green "docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up" "pnpm --filter @cantrip/glitch dev" "pnpm --filter @cantrip/protocol dev" "cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 pnpm --filter @cantrip/server dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 CANTRIP_WORKER_DEVELOPMENT_BOOTSTRAP=true pnpm --filter @cantrip/worker dev" "node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && pnpm --filter @cantrip/app dev"
